outcome.technical: Added scripts/merge.mjs (pure exported merge() + CLI), tests/merge.test.mjs (15 cases m1..m8 incl. b/c variants) and fixtures under tests/fixtures/merge/ (build/{web,api,introspection}.json, update/frags/api.json, synth.json). Tests were drafted before merge.mjs existed and failed on the missing module (first red: import error, merge symbol introduced by this task). After implementation: node --test tests/merge.test.mjs 15/15 pass; full `node --test` 149/149 pass, exit 0. Design choices: fragments sorted by area; identical elements deduped, differing ones renamed <id>-<area> (-2.. if taken) with per-fragment reference rewrite (edge from/to, entity.store, fk.entity, access node/entity, relations); access rows dedupe on node+entity with ops unioned; zones used by nodes but undeclared are auto-created (fragments do not emit zones, schema requires them); generatedAt/commit/project never invented (flags --commit/--project/--generated-at, else taken from --previous); update mode owns elements whose first evidence path matches the previous meta.coverage globs of the --areas (cross-area synth edges/access with evidence in an affected area are replaced, so the synthesizer must rerun for them); user fields: locked node keeps authored content with a conflict if the new analysis differs, notes copied onto re-analysed nodes, a locked/noted node an explorer no longer reports is kept with a conflict; synth edges/sequences/views by id, access/relations by key, optional synth.nodes guarded by locked, notes and conflicts passed through; output key-sorted and element-sorted for byte-identical runs; validate() gate refuses with exit 1 and writes nothing; --strict with conflicts exits 1 and writes nothing; usage errors exit 2. Dependants: docs/design.md (§5/§6 describe merge behaviour) still correct - consistent with what was built; skills/architecture-map/SKILL.md step 4 still says merge.mjs is 'not yet built' - now stale, outside this task's files, left for the later task that wires commands/SKILL; the other tests/fixtures/merge dependants listed (LICENSE, viewer bundle, prescan libs, agents, review skill) match only by basename 'merge' and are unaffected.
outcome.descriptive: merge.mjs now merges explorer fragments and synthesizer output into a validated, deterministic model while preserving locked and notes.
